job.job_description:
AI/ML Engineer Generative AI

We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI frameworks. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in AI application development, prompt engineering, cloud-native deployments, and integrating AI services into enterprise systems.




Key Responsibilities

Develop, test, and deploy AI and Generative AI applications using modern programming languages and AI frameworks.
Design and implement prompt engineering strategies to improve LLM outputs and business outcomes.
Build and maintain RAG-based and LLM-powered conversational AI solutions.
Integrate AI services, foundation models, and APIs into enterprise applications.
Collaborate with architects, data scientists, and engineering teams to implement AI solutions.
Conduct model evaluation, testing, optimization, and performance tuning.
Implement secure, scalable, and reliable AI development practices.
Support MLOps and CI/CD pipelines for AI model deployment and monitoring.
Create technical documentation for prompts, models, APIs, and reusable AI components.
Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices.
